sxir-pipeline 1.0
sxir (devel)
options start= source-info=false default-value=false left-recursion-bindings=false
settings profile= opt= no-opt=
debug verify-each=false print-after= print-changed=false stats=false time-passes=false print-before= print-pipeline=true
target ts typed-only=false recognize-only=false no-limits=false logical-variant= expectations=false observability=false document=false stream=false module= package= lib=import lib-module=./lib.ts max-depth=0 types=true recognize=false omit-package-doc=false convert-types=false keep-nodes=false keep-unreachable=false keep-comments=false feature-witness=false disable-keep-nodes=false
pipeline program -> output {
  with target=ts {
    with reach=none {
      each ts-tables {
        shared core-config {
          elaborate!
          slot core-passes {
            guards
            scans
          }
        }
      }
      each action-tables {
        with action-config {
          actionlower!
          func funcs@action {
            slot action-passes {
              text-dispatch
            }
          }
          func funcs@action {
            slot action-target-passes {
            }
          }
          func funcs@action {
            action-finish!
          }
        }
      }
      dispatch
      outline
      plan!
      each planned-tables {
        with table-config {
          with table-suspend {
            flowlower!
            resumable
            within module@flow {
              with flow-target= {
                func funcs@flow {
                  slot flow-passes {
                    terminals
                    guarded-classes
                    class-runs
                    class-tables
                    inline-literals
                    canonicalize[fold-constants,fold-branches,drop-after-exit,drop-unused-labels,splice-blocks]
                  }
                }
              }
              flow-finish!
            }
            execlower!
            within module@exec {
              func funcs@exec {
                slot exec-passes {
                  canonicalize#2[fold-constants,fold-branches,drop-after-exit,drop-unused-labels,splice-blocks]
                }
              }
              func lowered-funcs@exec {
                slot target-passes {
                  ts-merged-records
                  ts-tested-inits
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      ts-library!
      within ts-library {
        specialize!
      }
      ts-printable!
      print-ts!
    }
  }
}
